motion_rule: he rides a seaside luggage belt racing at the lens, the camera racing backwards ahead so the awnings tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; the belt carries him through every beat and he never works a prop standing; head half the frame, from 6.15 a low angle, head low; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; camera move every beat
character: a stocky green turtle in a tan visor, deadpan
second_characters: ONE scruffy gull skimming the belt beside him, snatching every falling coin out of the air before it can reach his jar
props: ONE brass jar with a fat arrow stamped rising up its side, riding on his shell; ONE gold coin in his claw
prop_continuity: the jar stays plain and empty to the end however much money pours past; the coin he drops in at 2.5 never comes back out
environment: a packed seaside boardwalk, striped awnings and stalls to the roof both sides, the belt racing under
light_events: hard noon sun through the awning stripes bars his face every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: vlo-ZHIL, o-be-SHCHAN-nyj, pro-TSENT, DEN-gi, po-KHO-zhe, ras-TUT, GDE-to, ye-SHCHO
audio.pacing: 0.4-2.5 one breath; the gap under one second; 3.45-6.15 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; after 6.15 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: the belt humming, the boardwalk roaring, a lid clap at 2.5, a far-off till ringing from 3.45, coins hammering the awnings from 7.0

timeline.a: he rides the belt at the lens, the jar rocking on his shell, awnings tearing past
he thumbs the lid off the jar without slowing
he holds the coin up to the lens as the belt hauls him along
the gull swings in at his claw and misses the coin
he drops the coin in and claps the lid, the jar sits plain, nothing happens
coins burst out of the awnings far behind him, never out of the jar
he twists round on the belt hunting where they come from
the coin fall sweeps down the boardwalk after him, the gull tearing into it
he snatches at the falling coins and comes up empty, the belt hauling him on
banknotes join the fall and stream past his ear
he holds the open jar up into the money and the gull robs every coin over it
the fall hammers the awnings the whole lane long, none of it landing in the jar
he shakes the jar at the lens, still empty, the gull hauling a fistful past him
he tips the jar over and his own single coin drops out onto the belt and is gone
he throws himself into the lens, deadpan, the empty jar at his ear, money pouring past behind

must_appear: one brass jar with a rising arrow; at 2.5 he drops his coin in and claps the lid and the jar stays plain; from 3.45 the money bursts out of the awnings behind him, never out of the jar; at 6.15 he holds the jar up into the fall and it stays empty; at 9.4 his deadpan face is in the lens, the empty jar at his ear
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, money coming out of the jar, money landing in the jar, a parked camera, a still background, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
